description: Use when someone wants to buy a used golf club and asks for deals, bargains or listings for sale, for one club (e.g. "deals on a used TaylorMade P790 iron set", "cheap Vokey SM9") or a club type (e.g. "used driver deals under $200"). Takes a club as the person said it or a club type, and an optional budget in US dollars. Returns up to 5 live eBay listings priced below what that club usually sells for (its median completed-sale price), with title, condition, price before shipping, the usual price and the gap, whether it is a great or good deal, the date it was last checked, and a link for each. Give each link exactly as returned (it counts the click and goes on to the eBay listing) and never build eBay links yourself; include the disclosure that Golf Club Index may earn a commission. For what a club is worth, use golf_used_value instead.

category.description: Club type when no club is named: driver, fairway wood, hybrid, iron, wedge or putter

club.description: The club as the user said it, e.g. 'taylormade p790 irons'. Give this or category.

max_price.description: Optional budget in US dollars, e.g. 200

name: find_used_deals
title: Used golf club deals below the usual price
